content_html_sanitized:
Source: http://www.marijuananews.com

Posted March 17, 2000
See
Executive Summary Of The IOM Report, Marijuana And Medicine: Assessing The Science Base
and
Will The Titanic Of Marijuana Prohibition Be Sunk By The Ice Cube Of The IOM Report?
-- Analysis.

One year ago today, the Drug Czar’s own Institute of Medicine issued its report, which explicitly said that " There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting. "
See
NORML Special Bulletin -- IOM Acknowledges:
" There is no clear alternative for people suffering from chronic conditions
that might be relieved by smoking marijuana, such as pain or AIDS wasting. "
But Still Opposes Smoked Marijuana --

Yes, there is an alternative. They can be arrested! Because the IOM report authors tailored their conclusions to be politically correct, the Czar has been able to use their long-term observations, that " the future of cannabinoid drugs lies not in smoked marijuana, but in chemically-defined drugs that act on the cannabinoid systems that are a natural component of human physiology " as an excuse not to change DEAland policies.
See
Column By Authors of the IOM Report On Medical Marijuana
Shows Why The Public Does Not Trust The Medical Establishment –
And Why They Should Not! With Analysis by Richard Cowan

In the meantime, it is still the official position of the DEAland government that sick, dying and disabled Americans are subject to arrest for using medical marijuana.
See
Drug Czar’s Office Endorses Arresting, Jailing Medical Marijuana Smokers;
Canada’s Parliament Resumes Historic Medical Marijuana Debate -- NORML Press Release

Although the Czar says that we need " more research ", the real policy is to continue to stall, delaying any research that would contradict the party line.

How this works was described in The Scientist magazine in May of last year, " Starting in 1992, Donald Abrams of San Francisco General Hospital sought funding for a clinical study of the differential effects on AIDS patients of smoked marijuana, Marinol—a tablet form of THC—and a placebo pill.(3) In late 1997, he received grant money for the study, which focuses on patients taking protease inhibitors. ‘We started the study last May and have now enrolled 35 patients out of 63,’ Abrams says. ‘The project should be complete by next January.’ However, his study was not approved until its focus was changed from the efficacy to the safety of marijuana. "

Other proposed studies continue to run into similar games.
See
McCaffrey Threatens Lockyer With Arrest If California Does Research On Medical Marijuana,
But Says " A Massive Research Effort " Is Needed To See If Marijuana Has Any Medical Value;
New Stalling Begins -- 3 Articles

Nonetheless, the IOM report was a political disaster for marijuana prohibition. It generated enormous favorable publicity for medical marijuana. Moreover, the media tended to focus, as they should have, on the immediate recommendations, that medical marijuana has genuine value. On the other hand, marijuana prohibition seems to cause long-term memory loss in the media. It has been a year, so now it is an old story.

Of course, the biggest problem for the prohibitionists is that the need for medical marijuana is very real, and the patients have given up on any hope of the government doing the right thing without political pressure and have taken to protesting on their own behalf, in spite of the risks and difficulties inherent in such actions, even for people with no health problems.

The response has been to escalate the lies and hatred, with the patients themselves becoming the targets.
See
California Narks Lie to Justify Disobeying Prop 215. And They Lie About Me In The Process.

The purpose of this campaign is to reinforce the ideology that motivates the cadres, both the narks and the die-hard reefer madness ideologues who make up the hard-core constituency of the prohibitionist movement. However, this campaign has the effect of further isolating the prohibitionists cadres from the mainstream.
See
Prohibitionism After the IOM Report; Analysis by Richard Cowan
Repeat After Me: No Medicine Is Smoked! No Medicine Is Smoked! No Medicine Is Smoked!
That’s It. You Are Now Qualified To Start Your Very Own Government Funded Anti-Drug Group!
and
Washington Reporter For The Scotsman Says
IOM Report Could Wreak Havoc With DEAland Drugs Policy:
" The government’s policy of arresting terminally ill users of cannabis
serves only to antagonise voters who may otherwise agree with an anti-drug stand. "
and
The Party Line Versus Reality On Medical Marijuana.
Prohibitionism Is Being Destroyed By Its Own Delusions.
Analysis By Richard Cowan and 1 Article
and
Panic In Prohibition Park:
How Maintaining The Party Line For The Cadres Alienates The Public.
Analysis By Richard Cowan

The longer medical marijuana is delayed, the greater the moral cost to all of our institutions will be. The following message from the front lines makes that clearer than anything that I can say.
See
Have The Sick And Dying Liberated Us Yet? Well, They Are Working On It!
